summary_en: This Phase 2/3 study compares izalontamab brengitecan (BMS-986507) with platinum-based chemotherapy, with or without amivantamab, in people with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer whose disease got worse during EGFR TKI therapy. The study drugs are given at a specified dose on specified days, and the exact schedule and treatment length are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record describes this as a randomized, open-label Phase 2/3 study.

who_for: Non-squamous lung cancer that cannot be treated with curative intent
EGFR mutation: exon 19 deletion or L858R
Disease progression on a 3rd-generation EGFR TKI as the most recent line of therapy
Eligible to receive cisplatin or carboplatin with pemetrexed, with or without amivantamab
not_for: Inadequate organ function or bone marrow reserve
Leptomeningeal metastases or spinal cord compression
Other protocol-defined inclusion or exclusion criteria apply
